title: Introduce smart column-snap, density presets, and multi-column sort affordances for Table component
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Improve the Table component to (1) introduce a smart column-snap behavior during resize to align to common widths and avoid pixel shaving, (2) provide a set of user-selectable density presets (Comfortable, Compact, and Dense) with clear token mappings, and (3) surface multi-column sort affordances and persistent filter chips for high-cardinality datasets. This ticket covers UX patterns, token updates, specs for the component library, accessibility considerations, and handoff artifacts for engineering implementation.
background: Recent customer feedback and internal usability tests show users struggle with imprecise column resizing, unclear density controls across the Console, and discovering multi-column sorting. Prior design tickets focused on virtualization and basic density, but we lack: (A) a predictable resizer experience that snaps to practical widths and avoids accidental narrow columns, (B) documented density presets tied to design tokens for consistent cross-component spacing, and (C) discoverable multi-column sort and persistent filters for workflows with sorting+filtering combos.
acceptance_criteria: Resizer introduces a snap grid: small snap (8px) and semantic snap points (min/medium/auto/expand) configurable via props
Density presets implemented with token mappings for rowHeight, padding, and icon spacing and documented in tokens reference
Multi-column sort UI added (shift+click to add columns) with clear visual ordering and keyboard equivalents
Filter chips persist above table when applied and are keyboard-focusable with clear remove affordance
Accessibility: resizer and density controls usable via keyboard; sort order exposed to screen readers; color contrast meets AA
Edge performance: virtualized scrolling retains frame rate with snap enabled for datasets 50k+ rows
Design tokens and migration notes included so product teams can opt-in without breaking layout
analytics_and_metrics: Measure time-to-resize metric (pointerdown->pointerup) and % of columns resized below min width
Track density preset adoption per product area
Track multi-column sort usage and filter chip interactions
Create perf dashboard for rows-per-second and dropped frames with virtualization + snap enabled
risks_and_open_questions: Snap grid might conflict with manual precise resizing—need an escape (hold Alt to bypass?)
How do density tokens interact with existing per-product overrides? We need migration guidelines
Engineering needs to confirm cost of live snap calculation on very wide tables and whether snapping can be offloaded to CSS variables
Internationalization: how will RTL affect snap anchors and icons placement?
implementation_notes: Create new token namespace: token.table.density.{comfortable,compact,dense} mapping to rowHeight/padding/gap
Expose resizer props: snapGrid, semanticBreakpoints, bypassKey (default: Alt), minWidth, maxWidth
Add aria-describedby snapshots for sort order and filter chips; ensure announce on change
Update Storybook stories: all three densities, snap on/off, multi-column sort, keyboard-resize demo
Provide migration guide doc with example CSS overrides for teams that used ad-hoc styles
